name: LightCarbon LCG074S-D
why_interesting: The separate-stem LCG074 keeps the 50C clearance, micro-suspension pivot and storage while making cockpit sizing easier to change.
missing: Current mainland quote, exact included package and delivery route
Independent measurement of suspension travel, compliance or frame stiffness
price_status: quote only; current mainland price unverified

facts.frame: LCG074S-D gravel frameset with separate stem, micro-suspension pivot and downtube storage
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with internal routing through the stem
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame including the downtube lid, ±4%; size 55 is 1,280 g; fork 495 g ±4%; stem 140 g ±4%
facts.cockpit: Separate 140 g carbon stem in 90, 100, 110 or 120 mm
facts.suspension: Manufacturer-described micro-suspension pivot; travel is not published
facts.geometry: Reach 374.1–397.1 mm; stack 542.6–627.1 mm; 430 mm chainstays; 70 mm BB drop; 62.7–69.3 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes frame compliance through its micro-suspension pivot but publishes no independent deflection or stiffness measurement

source_note: The exact manufacturer page identifies LCG074S-D as the stem-routed counterpart to LCG074-D and supplies its own package, weight and cockpit basis rather than borrowing the integrated version.
